notes: Each eval maps the fixture ledger to ./ledger.beancount and the fixture statement to ./statement.csv in a scratch dir. Expectations are graded against the skill's reported diff and any appended entries. Validate with `bea check` when bea is installed; oracle/CI uses `uv run --project cli bean-check` separately.
